description: Claude Code from Anthropic's dnf repository, found through its rpm package name.
why: The rpm_packages route's scenario for Claude Code, the rpm family's half of 89-linux-claude-deb. The package installs /usr/bin/claude and nothing under a home directory, so rpm's database row is the only evidence, and must_contain pins that row rather than letting must_find pass on another route. It also keeps proving what 77-linux-rpm proves: one composed artifact reads deb_packages and rpm_packages on either family without the absent table failing the statement.
known_gaps: Runs in Rocky 9, Fedora 41 and Amazon Linux 2023 containers on an ubuntu runner, because GitHub offers no RPM-distro runner. A container has no systemd, so `unit` is 0 here and the systemd marker reports absent, correctly.
The apk repository is not exercised, and could not be: no route reads Alpine's apk_packages table, so an Alpine install of Claude Code is a blind spot of the catalog rather than a missing identifier.
